name: ALGIERS / Houari Boumediene
location: 9.11 NM southeast of Algiers; TWY intersection B4, B5, A4, A5

sections.AD 2.2 Address: ALGIERS AIRPORT, Aéroport d'ALGER / Houari Boumediene-Alger BP 164 DAR EL BEIDA · TEL +21323199226 · TWR +21323199237 · APP +21323199232 · ARO +21323199231 · AFS DAAGYDYD
sections.AD 2.3 Operational hours: AD administration 0700/1500 (SUN/THU). Customs/immigration, health, AIS, ARO, MET, ATS, fuelling, handling, security, de-icing: H24
sections.AD 2.4 Handling & fuel: Cargo handling available. Fuel: JET A1, AVGAS100, Mobil JET2, JET4, ASTO555, Aeroshell 750/500. Pumps 50 m3/h; tankers 120 and 500 m3/h; hydrant at P10: 5 pumps 160 m3/h, 24 mouths over 12 stations (W1–W12). De-icing for Fokker with methanol.
sections.AD 2.5 Passenger facilities: Hotels 1 km; restaurants, bank/post at airport and city; taxi, bus, car rental; first aid at airport; tourist office available
sections.AD 2.6 Rescue & fire fighting: AD category CAT 9. Rescue equipment: yes, CAT 9
sections.AD 2.9 SMGCS & markings: ID signs, TWY guidelines and parking guidance: YES. Stop bars available on TWYs connecting RWY 05/23. RWY 05/23 lights: RTHL, RENL, REDL, RCLL, RTZL. RWY 09/27 lights: RTHL, RENL, REDL, STWL.
sections.AD 2.11 Meteorological information: MET office: Meteo national center of Dar El Beida, H24. METAR every 30 min, TAF every 6 h. Documentation: TAF, METAR, SIGMET, TEMSI, WINTEM (EN, FR). Sensors: sonic anemometer, rangefinder, road surface sensor, present weather sensor, diffusometer, digital barometer, T/RH sensor, rain gauge, pyranometer. ATS units provided: Ground, TWR, APP
sections.AD 2.15 Other lighting: Anemometer/LDI: north of QFU 05, landing T, windsock. TWY edge lights blue; TWY centre line green (except TWY CL related to RWY 09/27). Secondary power supply switch-over: 15 s
sections.AD 2.16 Heliport: FATO 72 x 26 m, bituminous concrete, PCN 38 F/D/W/T, 2 stands, elevation 18 m, bearings 180°/360°. Restricted use
sections.AD 2.17 ATS airspace: Algiers CTR: circle 6 NM radius centred on 364140N 0031301E; vertical limits 450 M GND/MSL; class D; Algiers TWR / Algiers APP (English, French); transition altitude 1200 M MSL
sections.AD 2.22 Flight procedures: Runway lap north of RWY 09/27 and northwest of RWY 05/23 for Category IV aircraft. When RVR is provided, it is used instead of horizontal visibility. Special VFR and VFR routing mandatory within the CTR. Helicopters: visual routing in CTR on authorization of Algiers Approach. RWY 09/27 usable HJ/HN; take-off QFU 27, landing QFU 09. Holding on DVOR/DME ZEM 116.6 and NDB MAR 416. SID is coded. OA holding remains residual.
sections.AD 2.23 Additional information: Presence of birds on the aerodrome. Mowing and permanent maintenance work on shoulders of the manoeuvring area. Aeronautical charges payable by VISA/MASTERCARD at the electronic payment terminal of the taxation service.
